paraphrase: Zurkhar Lodrö Gyalpo sets out the arguments on whether the Four Tantras is the Buddha's word or a treatise composed in Tibet, weighing its tantra form and origin account against internal signs of Tibetan composition.
speaker: Zurkhar Lodrö Gyalpo
notes: It is not certain that this discussion is in the Mes po'i zhal lung rather than a separate essay by the same author; his final position is not asserted here.
